metadata.title: Platform cloud implementations — RDS and S3 admission intent
metadata.remarks: The platform ships and claims these members (ADR-0017). A mapping is not an assessment of AWS reconciliation, an absent Bucket encryption configuration, or cloud networking. Only actual PolicyReport results enter the up-flow. Prepared publication, not a signed release claim.

components.title: Crossplane cloud admission
components.description: Hand-authored CEL members harvest collie's control intent; mutations tighten service dials without Deny.

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5.2.0; exact bare control ids

implemented-requirements.description: Observe RDS Multi-AZ and tighten availability by declared rung.
implemented-requirements.remarks: policies/require-rds-multi-az.yaml and cloud-cage-rds.yaml; primary mapping harvested through the incumbent collie rationale.

implemented-requirements.description: Observe supported server-side encryption algorithms on every rule and supply AES256 when absent or invalid, preserving aws:kms.
implemented-requirements.remarks: policies/require-s3-bucket-encryption.yaml and cloud-cage-s3.yaml. A configuration CR is the subject, not every Bucket.
